title: Appliance interlock.
officialText:
Each of the appliances served shall be interlocked with the mechanical air supply system to prevent
main burner operation when the mechanical air supply system is not in operation. The air flow and the damper operation shall be
proven prior to burner operation.
SECTION MC 707
DIRECT CONNECTION
